name: snackbar
title: Snackbar
description: Transient, viewport-anchored message with a single trailing action. Mobile-flavor of Toast — wider, bottom-anchored, action-trailing. Use specifically when the user just performed an action and may need to undo or continue. Auto-dismisses after 5 s by default. One Snackbar at a time per viewport. Distinct from Toast (top-right stack, multiple), Alert (region, persistent), and Banner (page-level state).
